description: EVM USDC → Falcon QUC bridge. Lock contract is N-of-M multi-sig (mainnet REQUIRED>=2). Deposit relay mints QUC; withdraw relay confirms multi-sig release.

custody.note: Deploy with OWNERS=... REQUIRED>=2. Single-EOA (required=1) is testnet-only.

deploy_notes: OWNERS must be multi-sig set; REQUIRED >= 2 (enforced by custody.mainnet_min_required)
Do not reuse Sepolia lock address or Sepolia owner keys on mainnet
After deploy: set lock_contract, flip status to mainnet when Falcon mainnet is live
Relays need ETH_MAINNET_RPC_URL / ETH_MAINNET_LOCK_CONTRACT env (not SEPOLIA_*)

falcon.mainnet_notes: On Falcon mainnet: new network_id, new QUC issuer from mainnet stables deploy, new RPC endpoints.

mainnet_gaps: Script is Sepolia-hardcoded (env SEPOLIA_RPC_URL / lock from sepolia block)
Need ETH_RPC_URL + LOCK_CONTRACT abstraction for chain_id=1
Issuer key custody: testnet single-signer; mainnet needs cold/HSM or multi-party mint policy
memo_type still sepolia-withdraw — use eth-withdraw or chain-agnostic memo for mainnet
release requires multi-sig confirmations from OWNERS (REQUIRED>=2)
Owner private keys must never live on the relay host for mainnet

mainnet_checklist: 1. Deploy FalconCollateralLock on Ethereum mainnet (OWNERS N-of-M, REQUIRED>=2)
2. Verify USDC (0xA0b8…eB48) allowance path and decimals=6
3. Deploy mainnet QUC issuer + stables on Falcon mainnet (not testnet issuer)
4. Generalize deposit/withdraw relays for chain_id selection
5. Multi-sig runbook for withdraw release (no single EOA on host)
6. Point portal bridge UI at mainnet lock + Falcon mainnet RPC
7. Dry-run small deposit/withdraw before public launch
8. Document freeze of bridge issuer keys and owner set
